# 2 Baruch Chapter 49 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**49:1** And I answered and said: "In what form will those live who live in your day? Or how will the glory of those who come after that time continue?"

**49:2** "Will they then take up again this form of the present, and put on these chains that are in evil, by which all evil things are done?"

**49:3** "Or will you perhaps change these things which have been in the world, as also the world itself?"

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
